scenario: A Juno-106 sound plays its note in tune and stops when released
name: hello, ST-71b: PRESETS to Juno Flutes (FM-106's engine, the owner's pick 3); C4 sounds C4, and stops after its release
note: hello starts on Basic: Piano (sound 1); the Juno's sounds come after FMini's 66 (engine 9), Flutes is sound 113. The 112 clicks take about 800 ms on the FM-1 (each one chooses a sound), so the key waits for them.
